description: Fatal System Crash (INV-04.pdf): Processing large files causes a thread timeout. The system freezes and aborts data saving without any error recovery.
Ingested PDF and PNG files are accepted by the UI, but the system fails to extract major information fields.
Multi-page PDF uploads are accepted, but the system cuts off secondary pages, leaving processing incomplete.
Automatic layout correction fails for images tilted at 90° or 180°. Text stays unaligned, breaking invoice number tracking.
The script lacks an auto-straightening tool. Crooked documents skip leveling adjustments, degrading final OCR readout accuracy.
OCR processes fail to handle bad image quality. Blurry documents cause corrupted strings, and low-resolution inputs give wrong values.
Preprocessing lacks lighting normalization. Document shadows mess up text boundaries, causing wrong invoice ID extractions.
Ingestion tool struggles with physical scans, full-color profiles, or raw grayscale grids, outputting distorted text values.
The system misreads text when logos or watermarks are present, and fails to flag missing fields on cropped or incomplete multi-page layers.
Mapping rules are inverted. The OCR engine reads the invoice Due Date and incorrectly saves it as the Invoice Date.
Character recognition layers misread symbols, resulting in failed extractions of currency symbols and special codes.
Calculation zones are uncalibrated. Totals and subtotals are saved with wrong values, and the Tax field is completely missed.
Vertical table grid boundaries are missing. The OCR engine cannot read item table rows, causing data drops for product items.
Test summary loops show character recognition falls significantly below the required ≥90% accuracy baseline.
System generates reading errors on reference tracking codes, and skips text extractions on secondary pages of multi-page invoices.
Extracted text data fails to map to correct layout blocks, creating critical mapping bugs for Vendor Names, Invoice Dates, and Currencies.
Local AI context misses numeric limits, saving corrupted database rows for Item Quantity, Unit Price, Tax values, and Total Amounts.
Prompts lack iterative row trackers. The model fails to process multi-row item tables or capture text from multi-page documents.
The front-end user layout lacks confidence metrics; field-level accuracy confidence scores do not display post-execution.
Missing field checks fail to execute. Invoices completely without Vendor Names, IDs, Billing Dates, or Totals pass without throwing errors.
Validation loops bypass formatting rules. Malformed date formats, future dates, and unsupported country currency structures pass with no warning.
Logic checks lack mathematical sanity limits. Tax inputs exceeding overall invoice costs, negative prices, and blank records are accepted.
Math parity verification fails. Validations overlook calculation errors where item rows do not sum up or where Total ≠ Subtotal + Tax.
Back-end error blocks operate under certain states but fail to display text message errors or warnings to the user on the screen.
Duplicate filters trigger false alarms, blocking unique invoice numbers from entirely different vendors, and fail checks on minor file updates.
Saved data fields have errors. Active database strings do not match extracted numbers, corrupting line item lists during save loops.
Search tools return zero records. Entering verified Invoice Numbers or Vendor Names into query boxes reveals blank result blocks.
Search keyword indexing runs inconsistently. Entering partial text strings outputs unstable and changing document lists across tracking panels.
Text-cleaning scripts damage valid text records. Normalization loops accidentally strip core layout IDs, causing the loss of Invoice Numbers and Dates.
Mandatory parameter capture features drop data groups on multi-page arrays and completely lose missing-field indicator flags.
Severe Slowdown: End-to-end processing takes 4 minutes and 54 seconds, violating the 30-second target processing SLA by an absolute 264 seconds.
Workflow loops pass broken data strings to the database. These faulty values map straight into user spreadsheets and downloadable CSV/Excel files.
Background tasks skip processing secondary pages, accept missing fields by formatting them as a hyphen - with no warnings, and fail to highlight low-confidence blocks.
